title: Shrimp Pad Thai
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, egg, bean sprouts and scallions in a tangy tamarind sauce, finished with peanuts and lime.

image.alt: A plate of pad thai with shrimp, peanuts, bean sprouts and lime

steps.text: Soak the noodles in hot tap water until pliable but still firm at the center, {time 8-10 min}. Drain; they finish cooking in the pan.
Stir the tamarind, fish sauce and brown sugar together until the sugar dissolves. Taste it: it should be sour, salty and sweet all at once.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in the wok over high heat. Stir-fry the shrimp until pink, {time 2 min}, then move to a plate.

Add the rest of the oil and the garlic, then the drained noodles and the sauce. Toss constantly until the noodles soak up the sauce and turn soft and chewy, {time 2-3 min}. Add a splash of water if they stick.
Push the noodles aside, crack in the eggs and scramble them until just set, {time 1 min}, then toss everything together.
Add the shrimp, bean sprouts and green onions and toss for {time 1 min}. Serve topped with peanuts, lime wedges and pepper flakes.

notes: Don’t over-soak the noodles; mushy noodles are the most common pad thai problem.
Cook in two batches in a smaller pan so the noodles fry rather than steam.
